FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Automotive Tyres, Tubes and Rims Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering Division Council. For the pvrposc of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960 `Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised )`. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

Indian Standard

AUTOMOTIVEVEHICLESTYRESFOR AGRICULTURALTRACTORSIMPLEMENTS AND POWERTILLERS - SPECIFICATION
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the dimensions and general requirements of tyres of diagonal ply construction for agricultural tractors, implements and power tillers. 2 REFERENCES The following Indian Standards are necessary adjuncts to this standard.
IS No. Title

ihall be made to IS 9081 : 1985.
5 LOADS AND INFLATION

PRESSURE

5.1 The load and inflation pressure of agricul:ural drive wheel tyres shall be as given in 4nnex B-l. 5.2 The load and inflation pressure of agricultural steering wheel tyres shall be as given in Annex B-2. 6.3 The load and inflation pressure of power tiller tyres shall be as given in Annex B-3. 6.4 The load and inflation pressure of tractor drawn trailer tyres shall be as given in Annex B-4. 6.5 The load and inflation pressure of implement tyres shall be as given in Annex B-5.

.4 DIMENSIONS ,4.1 The dimensions of agricultural tractor drive wheel diagonal ply tyres shall be as given in Annex A- 1. 4.2 The dimensions of agricultural tractor steering wheel diagonal ply tyres shall be as per Annex A-2. -4.3 The dimensions of power tiller diagonal ply tyres shall be as per Annex A-3. .4.4 The dimensions of the tyres for tractor *drawn trailers and implements shall be as given in Annex A-4. 4.5 The measurement of dimensions given in 4.1 to 4.4 shall be carried out in accordance with IS 10914 (Part 5 ) : 1988.

NOTES 1 Recommendedrim is the rim which gives the best fitment of the tyre for all conditions and types of service. A permitted rim 2 Permitted rim is any rim, in addition to recommended, whose Etment can be permitted. Design-wise permissibility of a tyre/wheel size is not to be used for new design tractor or implement. assembly are to be ascertained in consultation with the rim manufacturer and the tyre manufacturer. 3 Tyre SW or OW may increases or reduce by 5 mm for every 0.50 increase or reduction in ( nominal ) rim width code, relative to the recommended rim.

Standard Mark The use of the Standard Mark is governed by the provisions of the Bureau 01 Indian Stan&r& Act, 1986 and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The Standard Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufactures or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
